=== TOOLING NOTES ===
(1) slack-send still has NO --dry-run (NINTH night). The heartbeat's step-0 probe prints 'unrecognized arguments: --dry-run' AND exits 0 -- a misleading pair that would pass a naive exit-code check. Resolved by reading infrastructure/slack/channels.json instead; sofi resolves to C0AQ7964ZU6. Heartbeat step 0 should just say to read channels.json.
(2) dcg blocked a jq program because the STRING LITERAL inside it contained '->' , classified as core.filesystem:redirect-truncate-dynamic-path. Nothing was being redirected. Worked around by using '|' as the separator in the output string. New instance of the dcg-false-positive class; worth knowing that arrow glyphs in jq format strings are enough to trip it.
(3) jq scoping trap, cost one failed query and one WRONG RESULT that was nearly acted on. Inside `$E | index(.issue_id)` the `.` rebinds to $E (the array), giving 'Cannot index array with string issue_id'. Bind the object first: `map(. as $e | select(($E|index($e.issue_id)) != null))`. SEPARATELY AND MORE DANGEROUS: the edge field is `depends_on_id`, NOT `depends_on`. A query using `.depends_on` returns null silently, so the parent-child arm never matches and the epic-close scan falls back to the id-prefix arm alone -- which produced TWO plausible-looking false epic-close candidates (bd-triage-20260801-findings-j0a59, bd-ybvak) that vanished once the field name was fixed. A run that trusted the first result would have proposed closing two epics that still have open children. board-scan.md should name the field explicitly.
(4) `br comments add` was DELIBERATELY NOT USED. bd-9edhn documents that comment ids are per-DB autoincrement, so a comment minted from a fresh worktree DB can collide with one minted concurrently in the live checkout -- which already produced a duplicate id that made issues.jsonl non-rebuildable. Adding tonight's evidence as a comment on bd-pntbn was the natural move and was rejected for exactly this reason; a proposal bead was emitted instead (issue ids are hash-suffixed and do not collide). RECOMMEND the heartbeat say this outright: NIGHTLY must not write bead comments while bd-9edhn is open.
